title: UFO whistleblower David Grusch makes wild claims on Joe Rogan's podcast, says he saw aliens resembling 'Greek gods' and 'gorilla-reptiles'
excerpt: Grusch said that different types of aliens have been found on Earth. While talking about them, he said some of them looked like 'Greek gods' and 'gorilla-reptiles.' Many people who are interested in these kinds of theories and information have been shocked after this viral claim on aliens.
content:
A question that many people have debated for years is the existence of aliens. It has been a matter of discussion and many still believe they exist in another universe. David Grusch, a UFO whistleblower and former Air Force officer, may have made the wildest claim related to alien contact. Grusch was an officer at the National Reconnaissance Office and co-lead for the Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena (UAP) analysis at the National Geospatial Intelligence Agency.

In a recent appearance on The Joe Rogan Experience, his claim about alien contact is getting viral.


What did he say about aliens?

Grusch said that different types of aliens have been found on Earth. While talking about them, he said some of them looked like 'Greek gods' and 'gorilla-reptiles.' Many people who are interested in these kinds of theories and information have been shocked after this viral claim on aliens.


Another claim he said that left many amused was that some of the aliens have been documented fighting each other as well.

In a conversation with Joe Rogan, Grusch revealed that he has seen a video where corpses of aliens looked like Greek gods. He said that they look "very beautiful" and described their appearance as "bluish white."

Notably, he did not say anything about the date of the video he saw or talked about a particular operation. But, he claimed that he could verify the footage independently.

Were some aliens found alive?

Grush made another shocking statement and said that some of those creatures looked like they were "seven-foot-tall plus, gorilla-looking.” He talked about some of them having scaly skin and some looked more humanoid in appearance.

He told Rogan that some of the reptilians that were found alive were killed.

Talking about an alien transport, he said they were commanding a Tic Tac UFO.

Grush even claimed that some "small gray beings" were allegedly involved in a conflict with their counterparts, which has resulted in crashes.

He looked confident while making these claims and said that everything is going to be out in the open soon. However, these claims cannot be verified independently.
